title: Lunar Garden Bindings
description: Three men in brown suits and hats sit on a wooden bench reading a book, viewed from behind as they gaze at a large surreal orb floating in a brick archway. The orb contains swirling blue and green vines, papers, and a landscape, while a sign reading 'LUNAR GARDEN BINDINGS' hangs above with melting icicles and colorful graffiti covering the red brick wall.
prompt: Three men in vintage brown suits and hats sit on a wooden bench reading together, viewed from behind, staring at a giant transparent orb floating inside a red brick archway. Inside the orb are swirling blue and green vines, papers, and a miniature landscape. A wooden sign reads LUNAR GARDEN BINDINGS. The brick wall is covered in colorful graffiti and dripping with melting icicles and green slime. Surreal whimsical scene with a teddy bear visible in a small circular window.
